en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a large, organized parade or procession taking place on a wide street or boulevard. The participants are dressed in uniform-like attire and are marching in straight lines. On the side of the street, there is a structure with signage and a flagpole, possibly a reviewing stand, and some spectators. The general aesthetic and uniforms suggest a formal or possibly military event. The photograph has a historical feel, likely from the early-to-mid 20th century.
